copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或演示中模拟 macOS 系统通知效果
copy.tagline_en: Generate realistic macOS notification banners for video overlays or product teasers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate macOS notification banners in videos or demos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的公告或消息渲染成 macOS Big Sur 风格的通知横幅，包含应用图标、标题和正文，适合视频叠加或产品预告。
howto.when: 当你要求生成一个 macOS 风格的通知横幅，用于视频角落叠加或社交媒体图片时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 macOS 通知，标题是“新版本上线”，正文是“立即更新体验”。
生成一个暗色模式的 macOS 通知，应用名是“邮件”，显示“收到一封新邮件”。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude renders your announcement or message as a macOS Big Sur-style notification banner with app icon, title, and body text, suitable for video overlays or product teasers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate a macOS-style notification banner for video overlay or social media image.

say_en.text: Create a macOS notification with title 'New Version' and body 'Update now'.
Generate a dark mode macOS notification from 'Mail' saying 'You have a new email'.
